area.comingSoon: Dheebuu jira. Kutaan kun amma yeroo ta'e.

wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.locksHelp: Gocha tokko torban tokko, torban lama, ji'a tokko ykn umurii guutuu cufuu dandeessa. Qabduu balaa, gargaarsa deebi'uu, quunnamnii bilbilaa nageenyaa fi haqamni dataa gonkumaa hin cufamani.

community.noPhone: Lakkoofsni bilbilaa ergaawwan michuu keessatti gonkumaa hin mul'atu.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.meetingsTitle: Waltajjii tarkaanfii kudha lamaa fi fayyuu

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Sponsor kee ykn quunnamtii nageenyaa kee siq dhihoo qabi.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Kun dhugumaan data kee haqama, deebi'u hin jiru.
safety.wipeConfirm: Nan hubadheera kun dhugumaan data koo haqama.

reentry.tipsAnonymous: Gorsawwan maqaa dhoksaniiru. Lakkoofsni bilbilaa gonkumaa hin mul'atu.
reentry.tipPlaceholder: Tarkaanfii kana keessatti maaltu si gargaare?
reentry.celebrationFirst: Tarkaanfiin jalqabaa xumurameera — baga mana galtet.
reentry.crisisStep: Lakkoofsawwan kana amma olkaa'i. Dabalataan "Need help now" kan jubiiwwan hundaa gubbaa tuquu dandeessa.
reentry.resourceOnly: Qajeelfama qabeenyaa qofa — Groundwork kana hin kennu, eenyumaa waliin hin hojjetu.

steps.step4: Bulchaa dhimma kee waliin galiiwwan kaa'i
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Waraqaa gadhi lakkifamaa fi guyyaawwan xumuraa ilaali
steps.step10: Guyyaa fi haalawwan check-in jalqabaa mirkaneessi
steps.step13: Bilbila, email fi intarneeta bilisaa argadhu
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step31: Maatii kee waliin deebi'i, yoo barbaachise deeggarsa daa'imman hiiki
steps.step33: Galii tokko kan yeroo dheeraa kaa'i, guyyaawwan kee 90 kabaji

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Jalqaba irratti dhoksaadha. Yoo filattee qofa qoodi.

venue.placeholder: Bakka yeroo — kutaa saanduqa diimtuu. Suuraawwan bakka dhugaa hin kennamne; kun bakka dhugaa miti.

family.help: Maatiin waan ati qoodduu filattee qofa argitu.

readAloud.title: Dubbisa sagaleen
readAloud.help: Dubbisi sagaleen sagalee meeshaa keetii fayyadamee barreeffama dubbisa.

phase3.resumeHelp: Muuxannoo kee irraa resume barreeffamaa salphaa baasi.
phase3.headline: Mata duree
phase3.interviewHelp: Deebiiwwan shaakali. Leenjisaan kee qabxii fi gorsa tokko si kenna.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.geoHelp: Warri kaan magaalaa kee qofa argu. Bakki dhugaan gonkumaa hin qoodamu.
phase3.rideHelp: Konkolaachisuu gaafadhu. Lakkoofsni bilbilaa gonkumaa hin mul'atu. Bakka ummataa walitti dhufaa.
phase3.partnersHelp: Gareewwan xixiqqoo sadii sadii wal gargaaran.
phase3.caption: Ibsa suuraa
phase3.qaHelp: Maqaa dhoksee gaafadhu. Miseensonni fuulduraa deebisu.
phase3.merchHelp: Mallattoowwan koodii qofa. Homtuu alaan hiika isaanii hin ibsu, guyyaan hin maxxansine.
phase3.shareHelp: Kaardii tokko lakkoofsawwan guddina kee qabu.
phase3.archiveHelp: Ergaa ofii keetiif cufi. Guyyaa murteessaa banama.
phase3.matchHelp: Agent kee jalqaba agent biroo waliin haasawa. Jajjuu amma cufameera. Maaliif akka ta'e arguu, beeksisa gaafachuu fi irra deebi'uu dandeessa.
phase3.datingOff: Jajjuun cufameera hanga seerri guyyaawwan xiqqaa kaa'amutti.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Jalqaba as ilaali. Yoo barbaadde, sadarkaa magaalaa qofa: eenyutu gara waltajjii kee deemaa jiru ilaali, ergaawwan app kanaan wal quunnami. Bilbila hin jiru, bakka dhugaa hin jiru.
phase3.groupsHelp: Gareewwan fayyuu, deeggarsa deebi'uu, amantii fi hawaasaa magaalaa fi yeroo waltajjiin. Data fakkeenyaa qofa — tarree dhugaa miti.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Yoo namni gabatee irraa gara waltajjii kee deemu hin jirre qofa mul'ata. Gaaffii to'atamaa app keessatti maxxansa — sadarkaa magaalaa qofa, bilbila malee.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Waltajjii kanaaf konkolaachisuu waliinii hin jiru, kanaaf Konkolaachisuu nan barbaada akka kuusaatti mul'ata.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Konkolaachistoota ragga'aman qofa. Beeksisni tokkoon tokkoon eeggata daqiiqaa 2 waliin deemu; isa itti aanu dura ati mirkaneeffatta.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Weedduu fakkeenyaa qofa. Herregni tamsaasa hin jiru. Taphaataan keessaa mooduuliiwwan akademii fi koorsii cufama.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Muuziqaan yeroo ati mooduulii koorsii keessa jirtu cufameera.
phase3.shareWho: Amma: ati qofa. Linkii uumuun namni linkii qabu hundinuu dubbisuu danda'a.
phase3.suggestHelp: Gorsawwan qofa — homtuu hin maxxansine hanga ati dabaltetti.

crisisReply.onlyYou: Ati qofa ergaa kana arguu dandeessa.
crisisReply.openCrisis: Qabduu balaa fi quunnamniilee nageenyaa bani
